extracted.name: Shaved Fennel Salad
extracted.description: This shaved fennel salad is crunchy, bright, and refreshing! The recipe is simple and delicious as written, but it's also wonderful with add-ins like orange segments, thinly sliced apples, or fresh mint.
ingredient_lines: 2 medium fennel bulbs (thinly sliced on a mandoline, plus 2 tablespoons chopped fronds)
⅓ cup shaved Parmesan or pecorino cheese
⅓ cup toasted pine nuts or sliced almonds
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, honey, mustard, salt, and several grinds of pepper. Add the fennel and toss to coat.
Add the fennel fronds, cheese, pine nuts, and parsley and gently toss. Season to taste and serve.
